summary: This 8-K filed by Structured Obligations Corporation, as registrant for Select Notes Trust LT 2004-1, reports a routine distribution to certificate holders on the May 1, 2026 Interest Distribution Date. The filing discloses interest received ($204,375) and trustee notices, with no mention of any business combination, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or strategic change. No deal terms, pricing, premiums, or special-situation elements are present. It is a standard periodic distribution report for an asset-backed security trust, not a special situation.
